ai.seo_question: What does Surah Al-Kafirun command the Prophet to say regarding the disbelievers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as a complete chapter of worship in itself, recited in lieu of the other two during prayer, emphasizing the purity of Tawhid against the syncretic practices of the Quraysh. It establishes a definitive theological boundary, affirming that worship is due to Allah alone without any compromise or association, a principle central to Imam Ali's and the Imams' teachings on creedal integrity.
